name: yichen-ledger
description: 忆笺记账 — a local-first personal finance app for Android, iOS, Windows and macOS
author: yichen520-1

scripts.pack:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && cap open ios
